generationPrompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless albedo-only source tile for a low-poly fantasy alpine terrain material
Primary request: Create a repeatable alpine scree with sparse lichen ground texture for high mountain shoulders and exposed rocky slopes.
Style/medium: restrained painterly low-poly fantasy terrain, soft medium-scale detail consistent with Eloria's approved stylized ground textures.
Composition/framing: flat orthographic square tile, evenly distributed fine scree and small angular chips; both opposite horizontal edges and opposite vertical edges join seamlessly on repetition; no frame, directional streak or focal stone.
Color palette: cool medium grey and muted blue-grey rock dust, sparse subdued olive lichen and a few warm-grey mineral grains.
Materials/textures: weathered small fractured scree and fine gritty dust with very restrained low-contrast lichen spotting; pattern should read at a 4 metre world repeat and remain calm at gameplay distance.
Lighting/mood: uniform neutral diffuse albedo, no directional variation or baked light.
Constraints: tile wraps seamlessly on both axes; color/albedo only, no height or relief shading; texture has moderate surface detail, not a rock prop.
Avoid: large boulders, centerpiece rock, mountain scene, layered cliff, high-contrast stripes, dense speckles, sharp cracks, snow, plants, directional shadows, highlights, gradients, perspective, horizon, edge frame, text, logo, watermark.

Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: square seamless diffuse albedo-only terrain texture
Input images: Image 1: edit target; keep the same cool grey-blue alpine scree palette and rare muted olive lichen color.
Primary request: Reduce the overall rock fragmentation again to make a calm gameplay-scale scree albedo. Let a soft fine-grained dusty grey-blue base occupy most of the tile; retain sparse small low-contrast chips and very rare lichen stains only. Remove the dense tiny-pebble speckle field and all prominent larger stones.
Composition/framing: flat orthographic square material tile with no framing; preserve seamless wrap on left-right and top-bottom edges, distributing details naturally across all edges.
Style/medium: restrained painterly low-poly fantasy material, broad quiet mottling with moderate detail.
Lighting/mood: uniform neutral diffuse base colour, no directional or baked lighting.
Constraints: preserve square both-axis tiling, cool grey-blue palette and albedo-only use; adjust fragmentation density and feature size only.
Avoid: dense gravel field, large centerpiece, large stones, dense tiny speckles, sharp fracture outlines, strong contrast, white marks, directional bands, cracks, snow, plants, shadows, highlights, gradients, scene/perspective, border, frame, text, logos, watermark.
